description:
We are Project Prometheus, a team from Thessaloniki taking on the challenge “Create Health Monitoring Software for Astronauts on Space Missions”. Like Prometheus, who brought fire to humanity, we want to bring data and technology to protect those who explore the unknown.

Our idea is to combine sensors/hardware with software that tracks astronauts’ vital signs in real time, analyzes the data, and flags early warning signs, with a clear dashboard for both crew and mission control.
